messages:
sam: DeployBot kicked off a config-only rollout for routing + batching params. ID: cfg_2026_03_21_15. Can we gate at 10% for 15m? https://go/release/cfg_2026_03_21_15 :deploybot:
deploy-bot: Deploy started by sam — config cfg_2026_03_21_15. Staged rollout: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-monitoring hooked. Reply `hold` to pause.
miriam: Hold please — ops wants a 15m quiet window first. Put in canary hold at 10% for 15m, then manual bump. cc @ops-oncall
leo: ACK. Watching p99 latency, error rate, and kv-cache miss rate. Metrics dashboard: https://telemetry/release/cfg_2026_03_21_15
ops-oncall: Heads up — last similar change bumped tail latency on 40k requests/s. If p99 > 600ms or error_rate > 0.5% during hold, rollback immediately.
sam: Set the SLO check in the deploy config: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 latency > 600ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> autosignal rollback. Also pin routing variant to v2-small for this canary.
leo: Confirming watchlist: `p99_latency`, `5xx_rate`, `kvcache_miss`, `queue_drops`. I'll keep an eye and post quick notes.
deploy-bot: Canary hold applied at 10% per request from miriam. Timer: 15m. Monitoring live.
ops-oncall: Quick nit — batch_window_ms was lowered to 8ms, right? Make sure downstream throttles are ok. If we see queue depth rise > 30, pause.
sam: Yes, batch_window_ms: 12 -> 8. Routing.weight for non-critical tenants: 0.12 -> 0.05. Added a soft-fallback route to fallback-model with lower cost.
miriam: Release note snippet for changelog:
- config cfg_2026_03_21_15: reduced batch window to 8ms; lowered non-critical tenant routing weight; improved fallback route. Canary 10% hold for 15m; rollback triggers on p99>600ms or 5xx>0.5%.
leo: +1. After 15m, if metrics stable, we can nudge to 25% for 10m and re-evaluate. Plan to fully roll in 3 steps.
deploy-bot: Canary timer expired. Hold window ended. Manual approval required to proceed from 10%.
miriam: Metrics look fine for hold. p99 ~ 380ms, 5xx 0.08%, kv_miss unchanged. Proceed to 25% when ready. @sam go ahead.
sam: Proceeding to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Progress update: 25% applied. Auto-checks active.
leo: Watching — initial spike in batch queue depth to 12 then back to normal. No anomalies.
ops-oncall: If any sustained spike (>30s) in queue depth or p99 trends up, call rollback. Otherwise green.
sam: Final note: pin cfg id in release notes and attach rollout checklist. If we need to rollback, run: `deployctl rollback cfg_2026_03_21_15 --immediate` and notify #incidents.
miriam: Thanks all. I'll add the changelog and mark this as config-only deploy in release notes.
